models_evaluated: OpenAI GPT models (ensemble of tailored implementations)

links.outcome: LLM ensemble risk-stratification agreement with clinician consensus on suicide risk levels
links.effect: Ensemble exact agreement 65.60% vs 30.38% chance (χ2 = 86.58); 92% agreement on intervene/not intervene (Kappa 0.84); 94% sensitivity, 91% specificity.
links.quote: Using clinician consensus as "ground truth," our ensemble LLM performed significantly above chance (30.38%) in exact risk-assessment agreement (65.60%; χ2 = 86.58).

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM performance (accuracy, sensitivity, specificity) for suicide risk assessment in synthetic patient journal entries compared to clinician consensus, without evaluating a specific deployment practice or safeguard intervention.
